8005.Name: Press the Attack
8005.RichText: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive basic attacks deals (40 - 160 ) bonus adaptive damage and increases your damage dealt by 8% until you exit champion combat.

8008.Name: Lethal Tempo
8008.RichText:
Basic attacks against enemy champions grant a stack, each providing ( 6% | 4%) bonus attack speed for 6 seconds.
At 6 stacks, your attacks deal ( 9 - 30 | 6 - 24 ) bonus adaptive damage, increased by 1% for every 1% bonus attack speed.

8009.Name: Presence of Mind
8009.RichText:
Damaging an enemy champion restores (6 - 44) mana or 6 energy.
Takedowns restore 15% of your maximum mana or energy.

The mana restored is 80% effective for ranged champions

8010.Name: Conqueror
8010.RichText:
Basic attacks or damaging spells against enemy champions grant 2 stacks of Conqueror for 5 seconds, each providing (1.8 - 4 ) bonus adaptive force.
At 12 stacks, you heal for ( 8% | 5%) of damage dealt to champions.

Ranged champions gain only 1 stack per basic attack

8014.Name: Coup de Grace
8014.RichText: Deal 8% more damage to champions below 40% of their current health.

8017.Name: Cut Down
8017.RichText: Deal 8% more damage to champions with more than 60% of their maximum health remaining.

8021.Name: Fleet Footwork
8021.RichText:
Attacking and moving generates stacks.
At 100 stacks, your next basic attack becomes Energized, healing you for (10 - 130 +10% bonus +5% ) and grants ( 20% | 15%) bonus movement speed for 1 second.

Healing is 60% effective for ranged champions.
Healing is reduced to 15% effectiveness against minions

8105.Name: Relentless Hunter
8105.RichText:
Earn stacks for the first time you score a takedown on each unique enemy champion.
Gain 8 bonus movement speed out of combat for each stack, for a total of up to 40 bonus movement speed.

8106.Name: Ultimate Hunter
8106.RichText:
Earn stacks for the first time you score a takedown on each unique enemy champion.
Gain 6 ultimate ability haste and another 5 for each stack, for a total of up to 31 ultimate ability haste.

8112.Name: Electrocute
8112.RichText:
Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3s deals (50 - 190 +10% bonus +5% ) bonus adaptive damage.

"We called them the Thunderlords, for to speak of their lightning was to invite disaster."
~ A tribute to Thunderlord’s Decree, whose wrath lives on in Electrocute

8126.Name: Cheap Shot
8126.RichText:
Damaging champions with impaired movement or actions deals (10 - 45 ) bonus true damage.

Only triggers on damage dealt after the impairment is applied

8128.Name: Dark Harvest
8128.RichText:
Damaging a champion below 50% of their maximum health deals (20 +9 per soul +10% bonus +5% ) adaptive damage and harvests their soul, increasing the damage of future Dark Harvest procs.

Takedowns reset the cooldown to 1s

8135.Name: Treasure Hunter
8135.RichText:
Each time you earn a Bounty Hunter stack, gain bonus gold starting at 50, increasing by 20 for each previous stack.
Collecting all 5 stacks grants a total of 450 bonus gold.

Earn a Bounty Hunter stack the first time you get a takedown on each unique enemy champion.

8137.Name: Sixth Sense
8137.RichText:
Automatically detect a nearby unseen and untracked ward, marking it for your team.
At level 11, the ward is also revealed for 10 seconds.

8139.Name: Taste of Blood
8139.RichText: Damaging an enemy champion heals you for (16 - 40 +5% +10% bonus ) health.

8140.Name: Grisly Mementos
8140.RichText: Collect 1 memento stack on champion takedown, up to a maximum of 25. Each stack grants 4 trinket ability haste. You gain 2 summoner spell haste instead in game modes without vision trinkets.

8141.Name: Deep Ward
8141.RichText:
Wards placed in the enemy jungle are considered Deep, gaining +1 maximum health and (30 - 45 ) seconds increased duration.
Trinket Stealth Wards gain (30 - 120 ) seconds of increased duration.
At level 9, wards placed in the river are also considered Deep.

8143.Name: Sudden Impact
8143.RichText: After using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or leaving stealth, your next damaging basic attack or ability within 4 seconds deals (20 - 80 ) bonus true damage to an enemy champion.

8210.Name: Transcendence
8210.RichText:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
- Level 5: 5 ability haste
- Level 8: 5 ability haste
- Level 11: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining cooldown of your basic abilities by 20%.

8214.Name: Summon Aery
8214.RichText:
Damaging enemy champions with basic attacks or abilities sends Aery to them, dealing (10 - 50 +5% +10% bonus ) adaptive damage.
Shielding or empowering an ally sends Aery to them instead, shielding them for (20 - 100 +5% +10% bonus ).

Aery cannot be sent out again until she returns to you

8224.Name: Axiom Arcanist
8224.RichText:
Your Ultimate gains increased damage, healing, and shielding effects.
Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces its current cooldown by 7%.

8226.Name: Manaflow Band
8226.RichText:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently grants 25 maximum mana, up to 250.
After reaching the cap, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

8229.Name: Arcane Comet
8229.RichText:
Damaging a champion with an ability launches a comet at their location, dealing (30 - 130 +5% +10% bonus ) adaptive damage at their location.
The comet deals up to 100% increased damage based on distance from the target, reaching maximum bonus damage at 750 range.

8230.Name: Stormraider's Surge
8230.RichText: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health within 3 seconds grants ( 48% | 36%) bonus movement speed and 50% slow resistance for 4 seconds.

8232.Name: Waterwalking
8232.RichText:
Gain 10 bonus movement speed and (13 - 30 ) bonus adaptive force while in the river.

May you be as swift as the rushing river and agile as a startled Rift Scuttler

8233.Name: Absolute Focus
8233.RichText: While above 70% maximum health, gain an adaptive bonus of (1.8 - 18 | 3 - 30 ).

8234.Name: Celerity
8234.RichText: All movement speed bonuses are 7% more effective on you, and you gain an additional 1% bonus movement speed.

8236.Name: Gathering Storm
8236.RichText:
Every 10 minutes, gain bonus adaptive force:
- 10 min: +8 or +5
- 20 min: +24 or +14
- 30 min: +48 or +29
- 40 min: +80 or +48
- 50 min: +120 or +72
- 60 min: +168 or +101
...and continues scaling every 10 minutes.

8237.Name: Scorch
8237.RichText: Your next damaging ability hit sets champions on fire dealing (20 - 40 ) bonus magic damage after 1s.

8242.Name: Unflinching
8242.RichText: Gain 10 armor and magic resistance when crowd controlled, and for 2 seconds afterward.

8275.Name: Nimbus Cloak
8275.RichText:
After casting a summoner spell, gain (15% - 45%) bonus movement speed that lasts for 2s and become ghosted.

The bonus movement speed scales with the cooldown of the used summoner spell

8299.Name: Last Stand
8299.RichText: Deal 5% - 11% increased damage to champions while below 60% of your current health, scaling to the maximum bonus at 30% current health.

8304.Name: Magical Footwear
8304.RichText:
Receive Slightly Magical Footwear for free at 12 minutes, but you cannot purchase boots before then.
Each champion takedown reduces the timer by 45 seconds. Slightly Magical Footwear grants +10 bonus movement speed.

8306.Name: Hextech Flashtraption
8306.RichText:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash, which allows you to channel for 2 seconds to blink to a new location.

Goes on a 10s cooldown when you enter champion combat

8313.Name: Triple Tonic
8313.RichText:
Gain bonus elixirs as you level up.

Elixir of Avarice (Level 3)
Grants 5 bonus true damage on-hit against minions for 60 seconds. When the effect expires, gain 60 gold.

Elixir of Force (Level 6)
Grants 13 bonus attack damage or 25 ability power (adaptive) for 60 seconds.

Elixir of Skill (Level 9)
Grants 1 skill point (does not exceed the cap of 18).

8316.Name: Jack Of All Trades
8316.RichText:
Gain 1 stack for each unique stat gained from items. Each stack grants 1 ability haste. At 5 and 10 stacks, gain 10 and 25 bonus adaptive force.

The following stats are eligible for granting a unique stack:
- attack damage
- attack range
- attack speed
- % armor penetration, lethality
- critical strike chance, critical strike damage
- life steal, omnivamp
- ability haste
- ability power
- flat magic penetration, % magic penetration
- health, base health regeneration
- armor, magic resistance
- heal and shield power
- mana, base mana regeneration
- flat movement speed, % movement speed
- tenacity
- gold generation

8321.Name: Cash Back
8321.RichText: Get 7.5% gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

8345.Name: Biscuit Delivery
8345.RichText:
Gain a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will every 2 minutes, up to 6 minutes.
Consuming Biscuits restores (20 +1.5% maximum ) health and permanently increases your maximum health by 30.
The restored health is increased by up to 100% based on your missing health.

Selling a Biscuit also increases your max health.
Maximum restore bonus is reached at 70% missing health.

8347.Name: Cosmic Insight
8347.RichText: Grants +18 summoner spell haste and +10 item haste.

8351.Name: Glacial Augment
8351.RichText:
Immobilizing an enemy champion unleashes
3 glacial rays from them toward you and nearby allies, creating frozen zones that last for
3 seconds + the duration of the immobilizing effect.
Enemies inside the frozen zones are slowed by (20% +90% +6% +7% bonus ) and deal 15% less damage to your allies (excluding yourself).

8352.Name: Time Warp Tonic
8352.RichText: Consuming a potion instantly restores 40% of its total healing.

8360.Name: Unsealed Spellbook
8360.RichText:
Swap one of your equipped summoner spells for a single-use alternative while out of combat.
Your first swap becomes available at 6 minutes, with a 4.5-minute cooldown.
Each unique summoner spell you use reduces the swap cooldown by 25 seconds.
After using a swapped summoner spell, you must perform 3 additional swaps before you can choose it again.

Smite's damage increases after two swaps

8369.Name: First Strike
8369.RichText:
Damaging an enemy champion within 0.25s of entering champion combat grants 10 gold and activates First Strike for 3 seconds.
While First Strike is active you deal 7% bonus true damage to champions and earn gold equal to
( 50% | 35%) of the bonus damage dealt.

8401.Name: Shield Bash
8401.RichText:
Gaining a shield empowers your next basic attack against a champion to deal (5 - 30 +2.5% bonus +15% of the gained shield ) bonus adaptive damage.
This effect can be used up to 2 seconds after the shield expires.

8410.Name: Approach Velocity
8410.RichText:
Gain 7.5% bonus movement speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions affected by crowd control.
This bonus increases to 15% for enemy champions you impair yourself.

Activation range for ally crowd control is 1000 units

8429.Name: Conditioning
8429.RichText: After 12 minutes, gain +8 and +8 , and increase your total resistances by 3%.

8437.Name: Grasp of the Undying
8437.RichText:
Every 4 seconds in combat, your next basic attack against a champion deals bonus magic damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health, heals you for 1.3% of your maximum health and increases your maximum health by 5.

Damage, healing, and permanent health gained are 40% effective for ranged champions

8439.Name: Aftershock
8439.RichText:
After immobilizing an enemy champion, gain (45 +75% bonus ) armor and (35 +80% bonus ) magic resist for 2.5s.
At the end of the duration, deal (25 - 120 +8% bonus ) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Aftershock bonus resistance is capped at (80 - 150 )

8444.Name: Second Wind
8444.RichText: After taking damage from an enemy champion, heal for +4% missing over the next 10 seconds.

8446.Name: Demolish
8446.RichText: Your third attack against towers deals ( 85 +28% maximum | 50 +20% maximum ) bonus physical damage.

8451.Name: Overgrowth
8451.RichText:
Absorb life essence from nearby dying enemy minions or monsters, gaining 3 maximum health for every 8 absorbed.
After absorbing 120, gain an additional 3.5% maximum health.

8453.Name: Revitalize
8453.RichText:
Gain 5% heal and shield power.
Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% current health.

8463.Name: Font of Life
8463.RichText:
Impairing the movement of an enemy champion restores (10 - 50 ) health to you and the nearby allied champion with the lowest health.

Healing is 70% effective for ranged champions

8465.Name: Guardian
8465.RichText:
Guard allies within 350 units of you, and allies you target with spells, for 2.5 seconds.
If you or a guarded ally take more than (40 - 150 ) post-mitigation damage during that time, both of you gain a (45 - 180 +20% +6% bonus ) shield for 1.5 seconds.

8473.Name: Bone Plating
8473.RichText: After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks from them deal (30 - 60 ) less damage for 1.5 seconds.

8992.Name: Deathfire Touch
8992.RichText:
Damaging a champion with an ability burns them, dealing (3 - 12 +7% bonus +2.5% ) magic damage per second. If the burn persists on a target for 3 seconds, its damage doubles for the remainder of its duration.

Burn Duration:
- Single target: 4s
- Area of effect: 2s
- Damage over time: 1s

9101.Name: Absorb Life
9101.RichText: Killing a target heals you for (1 - 23 ).

9103.Name: Legend: Bloodline
9103.RichText:
Earn up to 15 stacks through champion takedowns, epic monster takedowns, large monster kills, and minion kills.
Gain 0.45% life steal per stack, for a total of up to 6.75% life steal. At max stacks, gain 85 bonus health.

9104.Name: Legend: Alacrity
9104.RichText:
Earn 10 stacks through champion takedowns, epic monster takedowns, large monster kills, and minion kills.
Gain 3% attack speed plus 1.5% per stack, for a total of up to 18% attack speed.

9105.Name: Legend: Haste
9105.RichText:
Earn up to 10 stacks through champion takedowns, epic monster takedowns, large monster kills, and minion kills.
Gain 1.5 basic ability haste per stack, for a total of up to 15 basic ability haste.

9111.Name: Triumph
9111.RichText:
Takedowns restore 5% missing health, 2.5% maximum health, and grant 20 bonus gold.

“The most dangerous game brings the greatest glory.” ~Noxian Reckoner

9923.Name: Hail of Blades
9923.RichText:
Attacking an enemy champion grants ( 120% | 60%) bonus attack speed and deal (4 - 20 +8% bonus +5% ) bonus true damage for the next 3 basic attacks, increased by 1 for each basic attack reset used, up to maximum of 5 attacks.

This effect allows you to temporarily exceed the attack speed cap
